identified_issues: Erroneous automated compliance flag FLAG_SEQUENCE_DISCREPANCY generated by audit script
Auditor misinterpretation of autonomous injection sequence requirements under GRID-OPS-STD-2026
evidence: Local actuation occurred at 15:00:00.045Z, exactly 5 ms after the df/dt threshold crossing at 15:00:00.040Z, satisfying Section 7.3.1 (< 100 ms mandate).
Section 7.3.1 explicitly forbids waiting for centralized dispatch acknowledgement prior to actuation.
Transmission to the central dispatch ledger was logged at 15:00:00.215Z, an elapsed delta of 170 ms from actuation, well within the 500 ms window defined in Section 7.3.2.
Ledger record REC-994102 captured actuation and reception as distinct fields in an append-only sequence with zero record updates or deletions, satisfying Section 7.3.3.
recommended_action: Dismiss the audit finding, mark Event REC-994102 as fully compliant, and update the compliance audit rule logic to recognize valid autonomous actuation preceding central ledger entry as specified in Section 7.3.
